dedupe_keys.name: monitoring data from a large scale ultra high vacuum flat plate collector solar plant for district heating in racconigi italy

description: TVP Solar and AEE Institute for Sustainable Technologies publish operating measurements from Racconigi's solar district-heating plant in Italy. The Engie-operated solar field contains 525 high-vacuum flat-plate collectors covering 1,029 square metres and connects to a 350-cubic-metre heat store. The dataset covers January to December 2025 at one-minute resolution. CSV channels include irradiance, inlet and outlet temperatures, ambient temperature, flow and thermal output; a JSON file documents physical units and collector parameters. Zenodo makes the February 2026 release free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The file is labelled filtered, but the public metadata do not quantify missing intervals or every filtering operation. These measurements support thermal-performance simulation and fault-detection calibration within a hybrid heating plant. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. Only metadata were inspected.
name: Monitoring data from a large-scale ultra-high-vacuum flat-plate collector solar plant for district heating in Racconigi, Italy
